FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about the model and the current SdanceAI integration.

items.question: What is Seedance 2.5?
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 is ByteDance Seed's next-generation audio-video joint generation model for longer storytelling, multimodal reference control, and production-aware video creation and editing.

items.question: How long can a Seedance 2.5 video be?
items.answer: The model supports up to 30 seconds in one generation. SdanceAI currently exposes a duration control from 4 to 30 seconds.

items.question: Which reference formats can I use?
items.answer: The current SdanceAI integration supports image, video, and audio references: up to 30 images, 10 videos, and 10 audio files.

items.question: Does Seedance 2.5 generate audio?
items.answer: Yes. Native audio allows sound, ambience, and speech intent to be generated in coordination with the visual scene.

items.question: Which resolutions are currently available?
items.answer: SdanceAI currently supports 480p and 720p Seedance 2.5 output in MP4 or MOV format.

items.question: Can I use Seedance 2.5 through an API?
items.answer: Yes. The dedicated Seedance 2.5 API page includes request fields, examples, authentication guidance, and response details.
